PostToolUse.command: INPUT=$(cat); MATCH=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.. | strings' 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'git commit' | head -1); if [ -z "$MATCH" ]; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; LATEST_TAG=$(git -C "$REPO" tag --sort=-v:refname 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then CTX="No tags found yet. Consider creating an initial tag (e.g. v1.0.0)."; else COMMITS=$(git -C "$REPO" log --oneline "${LATEST_TAG}..HEAD" 2>/dev/null); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$COMMITS" | grep -c .); CTX="Latest tag: $LATEST_TAG | $COUNT commits since last tag | Commits: $COMMITS | Please suggest whether to push a new semver tag (patch/minor/major) or skip, based on the nature of these changes."; fi; jq -n --arg ctx "$CTX" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'
